description:
Anxiety Relief Music | Slow Sarod | 1.5 Hours

The anxiety was already there when you woke up.

Before the first thought, before the first task — the low hum of it, already running. This is for that morning. The one that starts heavy before it's even started.

90 minutes of slow Sarod in Raga Bhairavi — one of the most quietly powerful ragas in the Indian classical tradition. Bhairavi is a morning raga, but not a bright one. It's gentle and serious and deeply kind. It doesn't push you toward the day. It sits with you first.

The Sarod has a warm, slightly dark tone — close to the body, grounded in the low-mid range. Not sharp or bright. It doesn't demand attention. It just stays with you, phrase after phrase, patiently.

This isn't music to solve the anxiety. It's music to be present while it passes.

A quiet theta layer sits underneath at very low volume, gently guiding the nervous system toward calm without pushing.

Good for slow mornings, anxiety before a difficult day, sitting with your tea or coffee, or anyone who needs something steady to hold onto before the world asks anything of them.

Press play. Let the morning be slow.

0:00 Opening
15:00 Settling
35:00 Calming
60:00 Ease
80:00 At rest

If this helped your morning, feel free to like, share, or subscribe for more daily music.

— Raga Focus
